title: Design System: Aniekan Winner — The Systems Review Room

display.purpose: One dominant, expanded statement per page.

headline.purpose: Major section arguments and case-study openings.

title.purpose: Projects, roles, and substantial content groups.

body.purpose: Long-form narrative and evidence copy capped at 68ch.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive contact action on light surfaces.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The work-exploration action and secondary control.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.012 160); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 160); font: 650 13px/1.25 'Mona Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.965 0.008 160); border-color: oklch(0.42 0.12 160); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.42 0.12 160); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Evidence Chip
components.description: A compact proof or technology annotation, never decorative filler.
components.css: .ds-evidence-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.92 0.04 160); color: oklch(0.35 0.105 160); font: 650 13px/1.25 'Mona Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-evidence-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.42 0.12 160); }

components.css: .ds-case-panel { padding: 32px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.012 160); border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.965 0.008 160); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 160); font-family: 'Mona Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-case-meta { margin: 0 0 24px; color: oklch(0.43 0.022 160); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-case-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-case-copy { max-width: 58ch; margin: 16px 0 24px; color: oklch(0.43 0.022 160); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-case-link { display: inline-flex; gap: 7px; color: oklch(0.35 0.105 160); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-case-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-case-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.42 0.12 160); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Band
components.description: The signature causal story linking constraint, decision, and measurable outcome.
components.html:
Constraint

Clinical workflows had to survive unreliable connectivity.

Decision

Offline-first capture with explicit synchronization states.

Result

100% uptime for field entry
components.css: .ds-evidence-band { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.35fr 0.8fr; gap: 28px; padding: 28px 0; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.012 160); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 160); font-family: 'Mona Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-label { margin: 0 0 8px; color: oklch(0.43 0.022 160); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-evidence-text { margin: 0; max-width: 38ch; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-evidence-result { padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.88 0.13 75); } .ds-evidence-result strong { display: block; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-evidence-band { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; } }

narrative.overview: Imagine an engineering review in a bright room: architecture is pinned to the wall, decisions are legible, and one green status light signals that the system is sound. The interface should feel mineral, exact, and assured. It presents technical depth as something a visitor can inspect rather than something the copy merely claims. The system uses a committed field of mineral green, crisp neutral surfaces, expanded sans-serif display type, and asymmetric evidence-led layouts. Density is deliberate: summaries establish the argument, while outcome bands, architecture notes, and case-study details provide proof. Motion is responsive rather than theatrical—one restrained first-load sequence may establish hierarchy, while component feedback remains immediate and quiet. This is not a generic developer template, flashy startup marketing, a corporate résumé site, or an overly experimental art piece. It is a professional identity with enough character to be memorable and enough restraint to keep the work authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Committed mineral green balanced by pure white and carbon ink
Expanded, confident display typography without serif or monospace costume
Evidence-led composition with asymmetric rhythm and clear reading paths
Flat, structural surfaces with depth reserved for true overlays
Responsive motion that always preserves reduced-motion access

rules.name: The Committed Field Rule
rules.body: Mineral green must occupy 30–40% of the home-page experience through a few decisive surfaces, not dozens of small accents.

rules.name: The Calibration Rule
rules.body: Calibration amber appears only where it communicates verification, status, or one deliberate focal point; decorative amber is prohibited.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Carbon ink on canvas white, measured muted on canvas white, white on mineral green, and carbon ink on calibration amber are the canonical accessible pairs. Never improvise low-contrast text colors.

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: Use Mona Sans width, optical size, weight, and scale to create contrast; do not introduce a decorative serif or routine monospace companion.

rules.name: The Evidence Reads First Rule
rules.body: Typography must make the claim, evidence, and outcome distinguishable at a glance without relying on tiny uppercase eyebrows.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Case studies, proof bands, and buttons stay flat. If a bordered surface also has a wide soft shadow, the design has failed.

dos: Do let mineral green carry 30–40% of key pages through a few large, purposeful fields.
Do connect every important capability to a shipped artifact, measurable outcome, or architectural decision.
Do use asymmetric evidence bands and varied section spacing to create rhythm while preserving a clear reading order.
Do keep body copy within 68ch and maintain WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, focus, keyboard, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use calibration amber only for verified outcomes, active status, or one deliberate point of emphasis.
Do verify long project names and technical terms at every responsive breakpoint before shipping.
donts: Don't make this look like a generic developer template.
Don't use flashy startup marketing, fake urgency, inflated claims, or decorative growth graphics.
Don't reduce the experience to a corporate résumé site made of stacked employment cards.
Don't turn the portfolio into an overly experimental art piece that obstructs evidence or navigation.
Don't use tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section, gradient text, decorative grid backgrounds, glassmorphism, or colored side-stripe borders.
Don't use identical card grids when a narrative list, evidence band, timeline, or full-width case study communicates the work more clearly.
Don't exceed 12px corner radii on containers or pair a 1px border with a decorative shadow wider than 8px.
Don't use monospace as shorthand for technical credibility; code samples are the only exception.
